description: This file defines an abstract class TransactionManagerBase that manages database transactions within Drupal, including nested transactions, savepoints, and transaction callbacks. It handles transaction state, stack management, and interaction with the database connection.

classes.name: TransactionManagerBase
classes.description: Abstract class providing transaction management, including nested transactions, savepoints, and callbacks, for Drupal's database layer.

methods.name: stackDepth
methods.description: Returns the current depth of the transaction stack.

methods.name: commitAll
methods.description: Commits all transactions in the stack, used as a workaround for object destruction order issues.

methods.name: addStackItem
methods.description: Adds a transaction stack item with a unique ID.

methods.name: removeStackItem
methods.description: Removes a transaction stack item by ID.

methods.name: voidStackItem
methods.description: Voids a transaction stack item, moving it to voidedItems.

methods.name: dumpStackItemsAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current transaction stack.

methods.name: inTransaction
methods.description: Checks if a transaction is currently active.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Starts a new transaction or savepoint, returning a Transaction object.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Finalizes a transaction or savepoint, processing callbacks if needed.

methods.name: unpile
methods.description: Commits or releases a transaction or savepoint by ID.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits a specific transaction or savepoint, managing savepoint release or root commit.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back a transaction or savepoint by ID.

methods.name: addPostTransactionCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be executed after transaction completion.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a transaction with a given name exists in the stack.

methods.name: setConnectionTransactionState
methods.description: Sets the current state of the client connection transaction.

methods.name: getConnectionTransactionState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the client connection transaction.

methods.name: processRootRollback
methods.description: Handles rollback of the root transaction.

methods.name: processRootCommit
methods.description: Handles commit of the root transaction, throwing exception if failed.

methods.name: processPostTransactionCallbacks
methods.description: Executes all registered post-transaction callbacks.

methods.name: beginClientTransaction
methods.description: Abstract method to begin a client transaction.

methods.name: addClientSavepoint
methods.description: Creates a savepoint on the client connection.

methods.name: rollbackClientSavepoint
methods.description: Rolls back to a savepoint on the client connection.

methods.name: releaseClientSavepoint
methods.description: Releases a savepoint on the client connection.

methods.name: rollbackClientTransaction
methods.description: Abstract method to rollback a client transaction.

methods.name: commitClientTransaction
methods.description: Abstract method to commit a client transaction.

methods.name: voidClientTransaction
methods.description: Voids the current client transaction, marking the connection state as Voided.
